content.short: Meso Finance is a capital-efficient money market on Aptos designed for low-latency borrowing and lending.
content.description:
Meso Finance is a high-performance, non-custodial decentralized lending protocol built natively on the Aptos blockchain. Designed for maximum capital efficiency, the platform provides a professional money market environment where users can supply assets to earn interest and borrow against them with sub-second finality. By leveraging the high throughput and security of the Move programming language, Meso Finance delivers a seamless and highly responsive user experience typically associated with centralized platforms.

The protocol utilizes a points-based incentive system to reward early participants and liquidity providers, fostering a vibrant and community-driven ecosystem. As a core component of the Aptos DeFi landscape, Meso Finance focuses on providing institutional-grade risk management and deep liquidity for major assets. Through its commitment to transparency and user sovereignty, Meso Finance is empowering participants to build and manage sophisticated decentralized portfolios within the rapidly evolving Move-based ecosystem.
content.meta: Meso Finance offers decentralized lending and borrowing on Aptos with low latency and high capital efficiency.
